source: Figma MCP use_figma, session 51307544-dbff-40ce-b63f-0aded50b66e8, 2026-10-22. Fresh read-only exportComponents() from design/figma/components.export.js, one page context per call, after page reorganization and creation of the GIS and healthcare icon sets. Four page exports were transferred in nine LZW-compressed slices and decoded with verified length and FNV-1a checksums: Primitives 449006/1169077545; Composed components 553127/107971310; AI components 279668/1374620522; Icons 151359/132732527. Foundations contains no components. All 203 prior family IDs, 533 prior component IDs and 169 nested-instance edges are preserved. The Plugin API exposes no file version or lastModified. Targeted refresh after layout repairs and avatar appearance work: session dea6c8f6-08d3-4ba0-82b4-7e208345aae8, read-only exportComponents() for Primitives (length 454043, FNV-1a 3079122047) and Composed components (553127, 107971310), transferred in six checked LZW slices. Other pages retained from the preceding export. All 661 preceding component IDs remain; 24 avatar appearance variants were added, with one shared AvatarItem reference edge (24 instances). Icons-only refresh, session 9ab0ff68-e465-4e96-b02a-07b61e1d5832: 12 disjoint sorted exportComponents() batches, each decoded with verified UTF-16 length and FNV-1a checksum. One consolidated catalog with 1,153 editable original outline icon components (913 General, 175 GIS, 65 Healthcare), covering all 3,170 reference IDs in gis-icons.json. All 685 preceding component IDs and all 170 reuse edges are preserved. Other pages retained from the prior snapshot. Icons-only refresh, session 9ab0ff68-e465-4e96-b02a-07b61e1d5832: 12 disjoint sorted exportComponents() batches, each decoded with verified UTF-16 length and FNV-1a checksum. One consolidated catalog with 1,153 editable original outline icon components (913 General, 175 GIS, 65 Healthcare), covering all 3,170 reference IDs in gis-icons.json. All 685 preceding component IDs and all 170 reuse edges are preserved. Other pages retained from the prior snapshot. Healthcare-only expansion, session ae8e7a5d-40b3-4d67-afd3-7dea1bd5b14e: fresh read-only exportComponents() in eight disjoint sorted batches, transferred with verified UTF-16 lengths and FNV-1a checksums. All 746 healthcare-only-icons.json IDs are indexed, with 570 new original outline assets and 37 existing canonical assets reused. Icons total 1,723 (913 General, 175 GIS, 635 Healthcare); all 1,676 preceding definition IDs and all 170 reuse edges remain. Other components retained from the prior snapshot. Full icon consistency audit, session c94aad69-1bdd-48a4-a5b7-6e1d3c643b3a: all 1723 existing canvases and 5809 physical vector strokes verified in Figma; artwork and IDs unchanged. 68 icons reassigned by semantic purpose, with 949 General, 156 GIS and 618 Healthcare. Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.
